body.instructions: CONTEXT: This is a transcript of part of an outpatient consultation, produced by speech recognition. Lines look like [mm:ss] ROLE: native text [EN: English gloss]. Some lines may be garbled. Code features are given as buckets (repeat_ratio, chars_per_s, language). Judge the words; numbers, doses and dates are compared in code, not by you. QUESTION: Is this transcript usable for clinical analysis? RULES: A hallucinated repeated phrase counts as garbled. A short transcript that is clean is still usable. Answer only from the text.

criteria.usable: The text reads as real speech in the right language and is clean enough to analyse.
criteria.partly_usable: Some spans are garbled but most is usable.
criteria.unusable_garbled: Most of the text is garbled, repeated or nonsense.
criteria.unusable_wrong_language: The text is in a language that is not what was spoken.
criteria.no_speech_text: There is no speech in the text.
criteria.not_applicable: The text is not a transcript of a consultation.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: The text is too short or too unclear to judge.
